latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release: video-auto-editing 1.0.0 brings fast AI-powered video editing for content creators and marketers.
- Upload raw footage (up to 500MB); describe edits in natural language; receive a ready-to-post 1080p MP4.
- Automatic session and token management with support for anonymous/free usage and credit system.
- Handles edits like trimming silences, adding transitions, syncing to music, and more via natural prompts.
- Supports common video/audio/image formats and provides clear guidance for all workflows and errors.
- Cloud render pipeline returns results in about 1–2 minutes for short clips; easy export and download.
